title: Bath dimension and initial entropy for closed repeated use of a quantum channel
summary: We characterize the bath resources needed to supply repeated uses of a fixed finite-dimensional quantum channel in a closed device. For each horizon $T$, one bath, one initial state and one repeated unitary are fixed before the user. Each output is returned before the next input arrives; no reset, discard, fresh ancilla or uncounted controller is available. Approximation error must vanish against arbitrary adaptive users with quantum memory and references.
